title: Materials
name: Material name
min_stock_hint: A "Low" badge appears at or below this
stock_unknown: Stock in this measure is not complete
edit_material_prices_hint: Sale and bought prices are changed on the Monthly prices tab; what a buy cost is changed on its purchase.
past_month_warning: Orders already saved keep their own prices; only new lines and stock-value reports change.
empty_body: A material is added when it is first bought: New purchase → Add a material → New material.
new_material_hint: A material you buy and sell — its name, code, its first buy and its prices.
prices_hint: This month's prices — type in dinars or dollars.
first_buy_hint: Which company it was bought from, how many arrived and what each one cost.
needs_buy_permission: Creating a material records its first purchase, and you are not allowed to buy stock. Ask an administrator.
add_stock_hint: A new purchase of this material: who from, how many, what each cost. It keeps its own price, so stock bought at different prices stays apart.
stock_by_price_hint: Every buy, oldest first — the order a sale takes them in.
